_comment: Presets for the focused-hours size scale (S, M, L, XL). Focused hours are the hours one person works with the agent from starting the branch to a pull request ready for review, with no waiting. A preset may override the scale for a story type (by_type). The person chooses a preset or types their own table; the choice is stored in team.json with its provenance. None of these is a measurement of your team.

agent_assisted.label: Agent-assisted work: S 1 h, M 3 h, L 8 h, XL 16 h (measured on one team's agent-assisted refactoring; replace with your own)

agent_assisted_refactor.label: As agent_assisted, with more time for CONSOLIDATE (S 2, M 5, L 12, XL 24 h) and MIGRATE (S 3, M 8, L 16, XL 32 h) stories, which need fixtures, parity runs and live data checks

conservative.label: Twice the agent_assisted scale: S 2 h, M 6 h, L 16 h, XL 32 h

human_only.label: Human-only effort without an agent: S 4 h, M 12 h, L 32 h, XL 64 h
